queries.title: Every span that failed
queries.why: The first search in any error incident. `has_error` is true when span status is Error.

queries.title: Failures in one service
queries.why: Narrow by service. `service.name` is a resource attribute set by OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.

queries.title: One scenario, using a custom attribute
queries.why: `lab.scenario` is set by hand in frontend.py. Every scenario shares one operation name, so this attribute is what separates them.

queries.title: Anything slower than one second
queries.why: `duration_nano` is in nanoseconds: 1000000000 is one second.

queries.title: Slow requests, not slow internals
queries.why: `kind_string` picks the span kind. Server spans are one per request, so you count requests and not every child span.

queries.title: One backend route
queries.why: `http.route` is the route template, so it groups all requests to a route.

queries.title: Find SQL by its text
queries.why: `db.statement` holds the statement. CONTAINS is a substring match.

queries.title: Slow database calls
queries.why: `db.system` marks spans from the psycopg instrumentation.

queries.title: Failed database calls
queries.why: The span that actually touched Postgres, with the failing statement in `db.statement`.

queries.title: Server errors by HTTP status
queries.why: `response_status_code` compares numerically here, so >= works.

queries.title: Client errors, which has_error misses
queries.why: A 400 leaves span status Unset, so `has_error = true` never finds these.

queries.title: Outgoing calls that failed
queries.why: Client spans are the caller's view of a dependency, including timeouts where the callee never reports an error.
queries.expr: kind_string = 'Client' AND service.name = 'frontend' AND has_error = true

filter.expression: kind_string = 'Client' AND service.name = 'frontend' AND has_error = true

queries.title: Hide the ASGI send and receive spans
queries.why: These zero-length spans crowd the list. See gap 6.
queries.expr: name NOT CONTAINS 'http send' AND name NOT CONTAINS 'http receive'

filter.expression: name NOT CONTAINS 'http send' AND name NOT CONTAINS 'http receive'

queries.title: Every span of one trace
queries.why: The saved example is the timeout run. The trace page is usually nicer, but this works in any query.

queries.title: A manual span and its attributes

queries.title: The manual cpu_burn span
queries.why: Manual spans make slow code visible when no library would have traced it.

queries.title: exception.type does not search spans
queries.why: Exception details live on span events, not span attributes. This returns no rows, with a warning. Use the Exceptions page.
